title: Side Path — Industrial Agriculture
purpose: Establish IC2 crop breeding as the renewable early source of fiber, string, adhesive logistics, and controlled livestock.

milestones.title: Crop Engineering
milestones.capability: Craft IC2 Crop Sticks and establish parallel breeding plots. Plant ordinary crops in single sticks; place double sticks between mature adjacent parents to crossbreed, and keep several plots running because each cross is probabilistic.
final_validation: Craft IC2 Crop Sticks and place them on hydrated farmland.
Grow two adjacent parent crops to maturity before placing double Crop Sticks between them.
Use parallel crossing plots so one unlucky roll does not halt the fiber program.

milestones.title: Breed Hemp
milestones.capability: Crossbreed and harvest IC2 Hemp. Hemp is a normal tier-3 crop: it needs light level 7, matures at growth stage 6, and regrows from stage 4 after harvest. Melon is a strong accessible parent because it shares Hemp's Green trait and close crop properties; pairing it with a different tier-2/3 crop such as Cocoa gives a practical early search. Hemp is the normal early renewable fiber source because spiders are not part of Industrial Civilization's ecology.
final_validation: Discover Hemp through ordinary IC2 crossbreeding rather than grass seed drops; try several mature Melon-plus-Cocoa or similarly diverse tier-2/3 parent plots.
Harvest a mature Hemp crop and retain the plant so its stage-4 regrowth continues.
Expand successful Hemp genetics into several renewable plots.

milestones.title: Renewable String
milestones.capability: Turn harvested IC2 Hemp into String through the native IC2 recipe and verify the repeatable survival route in HEI.
final_validation: Use HEI to inspect Hemp uses and find the native Hemp-to-String recipe.
Craft String from harvested Hemp without spider drops.
Keep enough Hemp plots operating to replace consumed fiber.

milestones.title: Controlled Livestock
milestones.capability: Combine four renewable Strings with tapped IC2 Sticky Resin to craft two Leads, move livestock into a controlled enclosure, and breed a pair. Managed adult cattle, pigs, sheep, and horses also provide a rare supplemental bone when killed by a player.
final_validation: Craft two Leads from four Strings and one IC2 Sticky Resin; the evidence is not consumed.
Use a Lead to relocate livestock into a fenced production area.
Breed a pair before treating livestock as a renewable material source.
